audit_findings.title: Non-current investment assets may be missing from the equity bridge
audit_findings.magnitude: $1,141.1 million, or $22.44 per diluted share; 7.4% of base-case equity value
audit_findings.mechanism: The valuation removes portfolio interest from owner earnings but omits latest-quarter non-current marketable investments from the equity bridge.
audit_findings.evidence: As of December 31, 2025, we have invested $3.1 billion in corporate debt securities and U.S. government and agency securities.
audit_findings.explanation: This is a demonstrated bridge omission: cash and current marketable investments equal the stated $2,662.3 million, while the separately filed $1,141.1 million of non-current marketable investments is not represented by that amount or the $170.3 million stakes balance. Adding it would raise base value from $304.83 to approximately $327.27 per share. That is material even though it would not by itself lift any scenario above the $487.61 market price.
audit_findings.action: Reconcile the June 30, 2026 cash, current and non-current marketable investments, and public and private equity investments line by line; then rerun every scenario and the buy-below price with the confirmed $1,141.1 million bridge addition.

audit_findings.title: Even the bear case may not capture post-2025 product erosion
audit_findings.magnitude: H1 2026 Nebulized Tyvaso revenue fell $65.0 million (20%), Remodulin fell $20.0 million (7%), total Tyvaso fell $25.8 million (3%), and operating income fell $90.7 million (12%) year over year
audit_findings.mechanism: Competition and generic entry can reduce the sustainable owner-earnings anchor and make the bear case require negative growth rather than perpetual maintenance of the 2025 earnings base.
audit_findings.evidence: Yutrepia competes directly with Tyvaso DPI, Nebulized Tyvaso, and our other treprostinil-based products.
audit_findings.explanation: The risk is no longer purely hypothetical: the latest filing says competitive therapies adversely affected sales, and material declines are visible in products central to the earnings base. The record does not isolate Yutrepia's contribution or establish the eventual steady-state decline, but a zero-growth bear case does not test erosion of a business whose treprostinil products generate the vast majority of revenue.
audit_findings.action: Construct and discount a product-level downside case using full-year Yutrepia exposure, observed 2026 volume changes, possible Nebulized Tyvaso and Orenitram generic dates, price erosion, patient losses, and separately evidenced offsets from IPF, ralinepag, or other products.

audit_findings.title: The unfunded SERP is a senior cash claim not shown in the bridge
audit_findings.magnitude: $54.8 million projected benefit obligation at December 31, 2025, equal to $1.08 per diluted share and 0.35% of base-case equity value; $63.4 million of undiscounted estimated payouts
audit_findings.mechanism: The existing unfunded obligation should either reduce the equity bridge or be explicitly paid through forecast owner earnings without double counting.
audit_findings.evidence: Because we do not fund the SERP, we recognize a liability equal to the projected benefit obligation as measured at the end of each fiscal year.
audit_findings.explanation: The omitted claim is demonstrated, but its filed scale is too small to affect the valuation conclusion: deducting the entire $54.8 million obligation would lower base value by only about $1.08 per share, versus a $304.83 base value and $487.61 market price.
audit_findings.action: Confirm the June 30, 2026 SERP liability and document whether forecast owner earnings include the associated payments; if not, deduct the latest funded-status amount in the bridge.

audit_findings.title: Pipeline growth may carry unmodeled milestone and royalty claims
audit_findings.mechanism: Royalties, approval milestones, manufacturing costs, and contingent consideration reduce future owner earnings generated by pipeline products or create discrete cash claims in the bridge.
audit_findings.evidence: Under our agreement with Arena Pharmaceuticals, Inc., we will owe a low double-digit, tiered royalty on net product sales of ralinepag (for any route of administration), plus certain milestone payments upon defined regulatory events.
audit_findings.explanation: Ralinepag is now a plausible contributor because its pivotal study succeeded and an NDA was submitted, while the scenarios apply 3% and 6% growth without identifying the products providing that growth. The filings establish low-double-digit ralinepag royalties and specified $250 million and $150 million milestone contingencies, but they do not allocate scenario revenue to ralinepag or establish which milestones would occur. Materiality therefore cannot be quantified from the present record.
audit_findings.action: Attribute scenario growth by product and indication, apply each filed royalty and manufacturing-cost structure, insert only milestones triggered by the modeled formulation and geography, and rerun owner earnings and the equity bridge.

audit_findings.title: The share denominator predates a known ASR settlement
audit_findings.magnitude: 215,948 shares, equal to 0.425% of the 50.844987 million denominator; approximately $1.30 per base-case share if no intervening changes offset the settlement
audit_findings.mechanism: The August ASR delivery reduces outstanding common shares and therefore the fully diluted denominator used to convert equity value into per-share value.
audit_findings.evidence: The initial repurchase of our common stock and final settlements under the 2025 ASR agreements, including the subsequent receipt of our common stock upon completion of the hedging period, were treated as a reduction of the outstanding shares used to calculate the weighted average common stock outstanding for basic and diluted earnings per common share.
audit_findings.explanation: The post-cover ASR delivery is demonstrated, although intervening option exercises, vesting, withholding, issuances, and repurchases still require reconciliation. In isolation, reducing the denominator to 50.629039 million would raise base value only from $304.83 to approximately $306.13 per share, which is not material to the valuation conclusion.
audit_findings.action: Roll the July 29 share count through the 215,948-share August settlement and every intervening equity transaction, rebuild the fully diluted ceiling, and rerun per-share values.

audit_findings.title: Public-benefit governance weakens the assumption that all residual value serves common equity
audit_findings.mechanism: Public-benefit capital allocation can affect the amount of financial assets available to shareholders, future reinvestment, owner earnings, and any takeover-related value not captured by the operating DCF.
audit_findings.evidence: There is no guarantee that our Board will resolve conflicts among the financial interests of our shareholders, our public benefit purpose, or stakeholders materially affected by our conduct, in favor of our shareholders’ financial interests.
audit_findings.explanation: The charter creates a genuine forward-looking governance constraint, but the record demonstrates no present diversion or impairment that can be deducted. The company also spent $1.5 billion on share repurchases during H1 2026, showing that shareholder-directed allocation remains possible. Future patient- or organ-program spending could destroy or create value, so its direction and materiality cannot presently be established.
audit_findings.action: Track actual capital allocation between repurchases, operating investment, acquisitions, and public-benefit programs; require explicit expected returns and cash needs before treating financial assets as distributable excess or operating capital.
